title: Full Ore Tools
description: Makes tools have the handle to be like the ore they are made from instead of it being made from stick
body:
This resource pack makes the handle of tools seem to be made from ore instead of sticks, this does not change copper tools currently

This was inspired by spears reimagined, there is also an [animated version](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/full-ore-tools-animated)


![The handles having their colour to match the ores instead of sticks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a63244e668262f83f44db6c15eb1c7b180e21528.png)
